escena: SCENE (staged, Efeonce studio at night, mid-work): a Chilean content strategist in her early thirties, dark hair tied back, wearing the navy Efeonce polo with the Efeonce lanyard, badge card turned away and unreadable, sits at a dark walnut desk and leans toward a very large external monitor angled three-quarters toward the camera, pointing at the screen with a pen, focused, caught in the moment she decides; nobody looks at the lens. The monitor fills a big part of the right half of the frame and shows a clean, bright editorial layout made only of soft abstract blocks, a large empty headline bar, three image placeholders and a thin chart line, no readable text, no logos. The monitor is the brightest thing in the frame and lights her face and hand in cool white-blue; a warm low practical lamp behind her right shoulder cuts a rim on her hair. One plain azure-blue (#0375DB) notebook on the desk carries the only blue. She and the monitor occupy the RIGHT half of the frame; the LEFT half is a calm, evenly shadowed bare dark wall. 35mm f/2.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark walnut desk, dissolved into blur and outside every beam

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed bare dark wall on the left half
